title: Trail-Cam Dawn/Dusk Shift
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gamecam:trigger
| eval daypart=if(tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))<12,"dawn","dusk")
| stats count as triggers by species daypart
| sort - triggers
description: Shows whether game-camera activity is shifting between dawn and dusk windows.
value: Small seasonal changes in timing can tell you as much as total activity when planning observation or trips.
implementation: Send trail-camera triggers to `index=personal`; compare species activity counts by dawn and dusk buckets.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces whether wildlife around your camera is becoming more active at dawn or dusk as the season shifts.
